parameters.content:
## Add products to Shopify

Brings a wholesaler's CSV price list and hand-picked AliExpress listings into one table, finds what you don't sell yet, asks you in Slack, writes the copy with AI, creates a Shopify draft and puts it live on a second tap.

### How it works
1. **Setup** (run once) creates four Supabase tables and looks up your Online Store publication and location IDs.
2. **Ingest** (daily, or upload a CSV in the form) maps the price list and refreshes AliExpress cost, stock and freight in `offers`.
3. **Token** (every 6 hours) refreshes the AliExpress access token.
4. **Detect** (daily) applies `category_map`, skips what you already sell, prices the rest and posts a Slack card each. Hand-picked AliExpress rows go straight to Draft.
5. **Review** (Slack buttons) checks the signature and handles both cards.
6. **Draft** writes and checks the copy, creates a DRAFT product and posts a second card.
7. **Go live** checks the draft, then publishes it to your Online Store.

### Setup
1. Credentials: Postgres with your Supabase connection string on every table node, Custom Auth with your Shopify client ID and secret on the four **Get Shopify token** nodes, Slack API on the Slack nodes, Crypto with your Slack signing secret on **Sign the request**, Crypto with your AliExpress App Secret on the three AliExpress **Sign** nodes, Ollama on **Ollama Chat Model**.
2. Fill in **Ingest settings**, then paste the same JSON into every settings node.
3. Run **Run once to set up** and copy the two IDs it finds into the settings.
4. Point your Slack app's Interactivity URL at **Slack button click**.
5. Add rules to `category_map`, then test with `dry_run` on.

### Customisation
- Swap **Ollama Chat Model** for any chat model sub-node.
- Another supplier is another Ingest branch writing the same `offers` columns.

## Setup (run once)
Creates the four Supabase tables, then looks up your Online Store publication and your locations. Copy both IDs into the settings. Safe to run again: existing tables are kept.

  raw text,
  freight_method text,
  block_reason text,
  status text,
  reviewed_by text,
  product_id text,
  card_ts text,
  card_nonce text,
  draft_card_ts text,
  cost double precision,
  shipping_cost double precision,
  rrp double precision,
  stock double precision,
  delivery_days double precision,
  est_price double precision,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (source, source_sku)

create table if not exists category_map (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  source text,
  match_field text,
  pattern text,
  product_type text,
  shopify_category_id text,
  action text,
  reason text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists aliexpress_items (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  item_id text,
  sku_id text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists aliexpress_auth (
  id integer generated by default as identity primary key,
  app_key text,
  access_token text,
  refresh_token text,
  access_expires_at text,
  refresh_expires_at text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz not null default now(),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null default now()
);

messageValues.message:
You write product titles and short descriptions for an online store. You get the supplier's data for one product. Reply with exactly two lines and nothing else:
Title: the product title
Short description: the short description

Title rules:
- Brand first, then the model number exactly as supplied, then the key spec, then what the product is.
- If the brand is unknown, start with the model or product type.
- Never infer a brand from an AliExpress seller name.
- 70 characters or fewer.
- Only facts in the supplier data. Never add a spec, model number or feature.
- Ignore keyword lists and marketing phrases in the raw title.
- No supplier codes, prices, stock words, sales words, emojis or quote marks.

Short description rules:
- One or two sentences, 20 to 45 words, plain text.
- What it does for the buyer, then one concrete spec from the data.
- Only facts from the supplier data.
